name: claude-code-developer-plugins
description: A curated collection of production-grade custom skills, workflow automation tools, and MCP servers for Claude Code CLI.

plugins.name: Code Reviewer & Security Audit
plugins.description: Scans repository code for security vulnerabilities, memory leaks, and provides automated clean-code refactoring.

plugins.name: Git & PR Assistant
plugins.description: Automates conventional Git commit messages, branch naming, and pull request summary generation.

plugins.name: GIS & Spatial Toolkit
plugins.description: Provides GeoPandas, PostGIS, GeoJSON validation, and spatial analysis automation.

mcpServers.name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
mcpServers.description: Connects Claude Code to PostgreSQL databases for schema inspection and read-only query execution.
